title: Gemini tool-message content must be coerced to a JSON object for functionResponse.response
answers: AI Gateway returns 500 for Gemini tool calling after the first tool result
Gemini via gateway fails with JSONDecodeError on plain text tool output
Vertex AI gateway tool result plain text breaks multi-turn function calling
functionResponse response must be an object Gemini gateway
body:
Symptom: Multi-turn tool calling through the AI Gateway to Gemini (or Gemini on Vertex AI) fails with a 500 as soon as a tool result is plain text, such as "Status: 200 OK", an empty string, or a list of content parts.
Root cause: mlflow/gateway/providers/gemini.py:GeminiAdapter.chat_to_model called json.loads(message["content"]) for every role="tool" message. That raised on non-JSON, empty, list or null content, and passed non-object JSON (number, string, list) through as response, which Gemini rejects.
Fix pattern: Route every tool content through mlflow/gateway/providers/gemini.py:_tool_result_to_response. It returns the parsed dict when content parses to a JSON object, and {"result": <content or parsed value>} otherwise, catching JSONDecodeError and TypeError.
Constraints: Only JSON objects pass through unchanged. A non-object JSON value is wrapped as its parsed value ("42" becomes {"result": 42}, not {"result": "42"}). Parallel tool-call grouping is a separate concern and is not covered here. Vertex inherits chat_to_model, so it is covered too. Regression test: tests/gateway/providers/test_gemini.py:test_gemini_chat_function_calling_tool_result_content.
applies: Any change to how OpenAI role=tool message content is converted into Gemini functionResponse parts in the AI Gateway providers, for chat and streaming.
says: Gemini tool calling crashes with a server error when a tool returns plain text.
Multi-turn conversations break when a tool output is an empty string or status.
Allow tools to return plain text or numbers instead of strictly JSON objects.
Vertex AI chat fails after returning non-JSON results from a tool execution.
Gateway returns an internal error when a tool provides a list of results.
search: Tool message content in mlflow/gateway/providers/gemini.py:GeminiAdapter.chat_to_model must be coerced to a JSON object for functionResponse.response via _tool_result_to_response. Only parsed JSON objects pass through unchanged, whereas non-JSON, empty strings, null, or non-object JSON values like numbers and lists are wrapped as {'result': <value>} while catching JSONDecodeError and TypeError. Parallel tool-call grouping is not covered here, and behavior is inherited by _VertexGeminiAdapter. Applies to OpenAI role=tool message conversion for Gemini AI Gateway providers in chat and streaming.
